_comment: Bible des objets. Un objet que le recit fait traverser tout le jeu doit
avoir la meme forme d'une image a l'autre : l'Anneau de Cuivre revient
dans 23 pages, les Amulettes sont le but de la quete. Meme regle et meme
palette que les trois autres bibles.

characters.look: THE COPPER RING: the ring ALONE as an object on the plain black background -- no hand, no finger, no wearer: a plain ORANGE-copper band, its flat face marked with a single engraved arrow that always points north.

aliases: Amulette d'Argent en forme de loup
characters.look: THE WOLF AMULET: one SILVER-WHITE amulet alone on a fine chain, its single flat medallion cut as a bold left-facing wolf head with pointed ears and long muzzle.
THE FLOWER AMULET: one SILVER-WHITE amulet alone on a fine chain, its single flat medallion cut as a bold five-petal flower around a round centre.
THE BIRD AMULET: one SILVER-WHITE amulet alone on a fine chain, its single flat medallion cut as a bold left-facing bird in flight. The false bird amulet is visually identical to the true one.
THE SPIDER AMULET: one SILVER-WHITE amulet alone on a fine chain, its single flat medallion cut as a bold spider with a round body and eight thick separated legs.

aliases: Amulette d'Argent en forme de grenouille
characters.look: THE FROG AMULET: one SILVER-WHITE amulet alone on a fine chain, its single flat medallion cut as a bold crouching frog with two large eyes and four spread feet.
THE ANTHERICA: a lush bush of dark GREEN leaves hung with clusters of small VIOLET berries; a single berry is the size of a thumbnail.

THE MAGIC STONES: precious CUT GEMSTONES that fit in a closed fist -- faceted like jewels, sharp polished facets catching the light, never smooth river pebbles. Each gem is a single flat colour -- ORANGE, GREEN, BLUE, VIOLET or WHITE -- with a bright glow at its core and WHITE facet highlights. They crumble to dust once used.
